summary: Iteration 33: Testing 'servico' field in proposals. Backend: 10/10 tests passed - all proposal CRUD with servico field, PDF generation with intro text, subsections support, and photo upload endpoints working correctly. Frontend: Code review and Playwright verification confirmed correct implementation of servico field, intro text preview with yellow background, and photo upload buttons in expanded sections.

integration_issues.flow: Playwright button clicks on React Native Web
integration_issues.issue: React Native Web TouchableOpacity components don't respond to standard Playwright click events. Workaround: Use JavaScript evaluation to click elements. This is a known limitation documented in iterations 27-32.
integration_issues.note: Code review confirms all UI elements are correctly implemented. JavaScript click workaround works.
